messages.subject: Re: [r-inla] Can one copy a replicate?
parts:
with

f(i, model="a", replicate=j, group=g)

if you copy that one, then the copy should have the same structure,

f(ii, ..., replicate=jj, group = gg)

so, the whole replicated/group'ed model, is copied.

H
